market.advice: Pre-open read (US open ~9:30 ET): a risk-off rotation, not a broad collapse. SPY ~739 is ~2.4% off its high and back under its 50-day (744) with VIX 18.8 and rising — the index has NOT reclaimed leadership. The damage is concentrated in mega-cap AI/tech: NVDA (-16% off high, TV Sell), TSLA (RSI 17), MU, AMD, AMAT, GOOGL and ORCL are all broken, and headlines about Nvidia's ~$250B OpenAI backstop are feeding 'AI-trade fatigue.' Underneath, money is rotating hard into quality value: financials (MET, PRU, JPM, BAC, ALL), REITs (KIM, SPG, PLD, O), healthcare (DVA, CVS, LLY), industrials/rails (HWM, UNP, NSC), materials (RS, NUE) and staples (CCEP, KO) are printing new highs. Notably, Apple is the one mega-cap still working — a fresh high and back to most-valuable company. Play the tape you're given: lean into A+ value/defensive breakouts at or near new highs, keep size modest, respect stops, and do NOT catch the falling AI knives until they reclaim their 50-day. Only A+ setups until SPY reclaims 744 with a follow-through day.
